statusHistory.note: Item 4 of the September 2026 SEO x RADAR-X reprioritization (BACKLOG.md), London martial arts angle. FIT-BOT's first byline (opportunities.md flagged this as the goal). Ishigaki Jujitsu chosen after Bartitsu was checked again and still has no visitable London venue (bartitsu.club's only London-area listing is the same unfinished Battersea study-group page rejected for Brockwell Lido). Ishigaki verified currently active: official site lists live 2026 new-joiner dates, Jikishin Jujitsu Association lists it as an affiliated club, and LGBT History Project + Pride Sports corroborate the 1994 founding and LGBT+ focus. Founded by four people in 1994 specifically so sexuality wasn't a barrier to training; won Out For Sport Club of the Year 2025. Classes: Tuesdays at Finsbury Leisure Centre (Old Street), Wednesdays/Saturdays at in2sports, Canary Wharf. Coordinates are a manual estimate for the Finsbury Leisure Centre area (Norman Street, EC1), not a precise geocode. Status held at draft pending near-illustrator's image call — no rights-clear photo of the club found in this pass, so a hero image still needs to be resolved (illustration tier per rules.md) before this can move to active; do not publish without one.
